scope.baseline: The three scoped files are untracked local additions. Staged diff and git status established the scope; full current source was read and a no-index diff against NUL confirmed the source-register addition. No PR was requested, so merge readiness is not applicable.
scope.mutationBoundary: Only this review artifact was written. Production code, research data, generated registers and test files were not changed; no provider or other network requests were made.

checks.command: npx tsx --eval (actual register functions, isolated from CLI execution; no test files)
assertions: Item evidence remains separate from menu and branch context, with correctly labeled item, menu and branch-only fallbacks.
Published rows preserve raw IDs and emit the actual normalized public food and section IDs; the matching public reference is consumed exactly once.
A menu held solely by boolean menu.held emits held and null public IDs.
Normalized food-ID and menu-ID collisions both reject.
An explicitly missing item source rejects instead of silently falling back to weaker evidence.
Invalid checkedAt, invalid retrievedAt and invalid retrievedAt accompanying a valid checkedAt all reject. Missing dates stay undated; retrievedAt fallback retains its basis.
Quote-required and historical-only price facts retain their unconfirmed or historical price-state labels.

checks.message: Menu item source register needs regeneration
checks.assessment: The expected regeneration guard detects concurrent research edits. All source resolution, public-row reconciliation and inventory food-total checks completed before the saved-output comparison rejected the stale register. This is an outstanding integration data gate, not a source implementation defect.

sourceAssessment: Exact dataset paths and their count are persisted from the same collected packet inventory. The long list is omitted only from stdout.

Dataset path guards restrict register traversal to the pilot file and research JSON paths. Source IDs, normalized menu/item collisions, missing sources and invalid authored dates fail before output replacement.

The register emits distinct item, menu and branch source references and a weaker fallback basis where appropriate. Dataset fingerprints preserve the reviewed raw context without claiming ingredients, current stock or future prices are certified.
Every currently published food must reconcile to a raw row; unmatched published references and raw-food total drift reject generation. Existing-output checks ignore generatedAt only.
The existing publicId behavior is exported for reuse. This change introduces no app/API response payload or client import of the generated research register.

independentReviewEvidence.note: All three current source hashes exactly match the independently approved general review. Its four resolved findings cover actual public IDs, boolean-held menus, normalized-ID collisions and source-date validation; those behaviors were independently exercised again here.

remainingIntegrationGate: Regenerate the research index/publication/register after data integration, then obtain a passing source-register --check. The currently saved register is stale for five dataset fingerprints.
limitations: Source traceability does not independently certify merchant claims, ingredients, transcription accuracy, complete stock or eligibility of every venue.
Research files were being edited concurrently; counts and fingerprint comparisons describe this captured revision.
